messages:
maya: quick question — seeing prefix cache hit-rate drop in prod-us-west since last deploy. Where's the canonical dashboard and who's owning the alert for kv_prefix_hit_rate? :thinking:
jeremy: panels live in Grafana -> "KV / Prefix Cache - Production". Look for panels 'Prefix hit rate by keyspace' and 'Top missy prefixes'. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/kv-prefix-prod
alex: owners FYI: alert rule `kv_prefix_hitrate_low` is owned by eng-platform team, current contact is @luca, but luca is OOO today. I can temporarily triage.
luca: (adding context) Alert fires when 5m avg < 0.9 for prefix hit rate. Rule link: https://alerts.redwood.net/rules/kv_prefix_hitrate_low
maya: thanks — any PromQL/QL we should run to validate quickly?
jeremy: here's the quick PromQL I run:
```
sum by (prefix) (increase(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
/
sum by (prefix) (increase(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
```
Works for per-prefix hit rate. For cluster-level drop use `sum(...) / sum(...)`.
alex: logs/traces: check Loki stream `app=kv-service env=prod` and filter `prefix="<candidate>"`.
Example grep:
```
{app="kv-service",env="prod"} |~ "prefix=([a-z0-9_-]+)" | json
```
Use traces dashboard to see if feeder requests are timing out before cache lookup.
maya: ok will run those. Is there an associated runbook for cache alerting? :grey_question:
ops-bot: Alert triggered: kv_prefix_hitrate_low — prod-us-west — Started 2025-11-02T14:02:11Z — runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.net/kv-hitrate
alex: runbook covers quick rollback (pin old model), bump prefetch sample, and temporary TTL increases. Also suggests adding a degrade-fallback model routing if miss rate > 0.2 for top-5 prefixes.
maya: I can own the alert for the next 24h. I'll open a PR to tweak threshold to 0.88 for prod-us-west and add runbook link in alert.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/1234 — description: 'tweak kv_prefix_hitrate threshold for noisy region, add owner=maya'
jeremy: quick code-review ping — left small comment re: alert label names. Otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:
alex: if we see repeated noise we'll switch alert from 5m to 15m window and add anomaly detection. Thanks maya.
maya: will follow up with results here after checks. :eyes:
